notes.title: Halloween Patch
notes.notes:
[b]HALLOWEEN UPDATE:
[/b] [b]Main changes[/b]:
		- Appearance of the competitive mode, players can now do a boosted solo survival and enter their scores in the local or world rankings.
		- Temporary visual changes to the menus.
		- The difficulty of the final boss battle in Arc 8 has been reduced.
		- The controls of the "Dangoal" mini-game have been changed to be more precise and faster.
		- Barbak no longer has danghosts skewered on his visuals after arc 4 of the story mode.
	
	[b]Debug[/b]:
		- Dangoal: The bullet no longer stops when you explode out of range.
		- Dangoal: Astral shapes no longer get stuck in corners when losing control.
		- Story: On Momoni's ultimate puzzle in arc 3, it was possible to miss the ending dialogue.
		- Environments: Candle flame textures now load again.
		- Environments: The beach colour correction has been reset to normal.
		- Versus: Power pop-ups no longer speed up each time they appear.


Learn more at https://steamcommunity.com/games/1812170/announcements/detail/3739736044830098000

notes.title: Halloween Update: Surprise!
notes.notes:
[i][b]Trick or Treat![/b][/i]

Celebrate Halloween on Otter Island with our surprise update, lovingly concocted in our cauldron!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346132/f7f7a8e05b880365f29a1e47d749eba1f24880a3.jpg[/img]

[b]Halloween event for a limited time:[/b]
[list]
[*] Everyone's dressed up for Halloween on Otter Island! Check out the exclusive visuals in the game menus. We know how to party here!
[/list]
[b]New game mode:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Competitive mode[/b]: Players can now play a boosted solo survival game and enter their score in the local or world rankings. Who will be the best exorcist in the world?
[/list]
[b]Important changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The difficulty of the final boss battle in Arc 8 has been reduced.
[*] The controls for the "Dangoal" mini-game have been changed to be more precise and faster.
[*] Barbak no longer has danghosts skewered on his visuals after arc 4 of the story mode.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dangoal: The ball no longer stops when we explode out of range.
[*] Dangoal: Astral shapes no longer get stuck in corners when you lose control.
[*] Story: On Momoni's ultimate puzzle in arc 3, it was possible to not trigger the ending dialogue.
[*] Environments: Candle flame textures now load again.
[*] Environments: The beach colour correction has been reset to normal.
[*] Versus: Power pop-ups no longer speed up each time they appear.
[/list]

Thank you all for your invaluable feedback. Don't hesitate to contact us on our social channels and come chat about the game on [url=bit.ly/UmeshuLoversDiscord]our Discord server[/url] !

Have fun and a very happy Halloween to you all!

notes.title: Minor Patch : Faster loading time for slow configurations
notes.notes:

- Made the Arc 6's boss a bit easier and made sure the players couldn't be stucked
